review_notes:
The file has one theorem, `small_metric_prepared_family`, and declares no simp lemmas or attributes. The only simp use is a local `simp only [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]` inside the `hscaled` proof, plus two `by simp` side goals. I found no competing rules, unwanted expansion or loop risk.

I looked at the `mfderiv (r • G) p` rewrite. Mathlib's `const_smul_mfderiv` (Mathlib/Geometry/Manifold/MFDeriv/SpecificFunctions.lean) has the form `mfderiv% (s • f) z = s • mfderiv% f z` and needs the hypothesis `MDiffAt f z`. A conditional rewrite like that is not a sound unconditional simp lemma, so adding `@[simp]` to it would not be justified. The `change` steps are about coercion unfolding, not about a missing simp rule.

The same `hscaled` injectivity block also appears in UniformStartingFamily.lean, SmallMetricStartingFamily.lean and ReferenceStartingFamily.lean. That is duplication, which this rubric does not cover. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out a simp issue that only shows up when the proof elaborates.
